correctness.rationale: Militaru Corollary 2.13 provides the exact finite orbit count and Proposition 2.15 identifies stabilizers. Uniform Stirling bounds imply the log-summand function \(m(n-m)(\log m-1)\). Its strict saddle has \(x_L=1/2+1/(4\log n)+O((\log n)^{-2})\), yielding the explicit \(1/16\) correction. The fixed-tuple count for \(S_m	imes S_k\), using the minimal nonidentity conjugacy class size \(m(m-1)/2\), bounds the total nonidentity Burnside contribution by \(o(1)\) near the saddle. Burnside gives the relative orbit approximation and a ≤ twice-the-Burnside-error bound on nontrivial stabilizer orbits, proving generic rigidity. The verifier exhausts published enumerations at \(n\le8\); it does not prove the asymptotic.

value.rationale: These are meaningful structural invariants of a recently introduced finite algebraic family: an exact second-order logarithmic growth coefficient, a sharp \(n/\log n\) probabilistic block bias, and a class-uniform generic automorphism result. The results distinguish the natural split and nonsplit strata and provide new quantified behavior not contained in a balanced-partition approximation.
